entities.name: Charles E. Brady Jr.
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Charles Eldon Brady Jr. was an American physician, a captain in the United States Navy and a NASA astronaut. He spent 16 days in space on the Space Shuttle's STS-78 flight in 1996.
